title: Ultra Clean Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Ultra Clean Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: UCTT), today reported its financial results for the second quarter ended June 26, 2026. "UCT delivered second quarter results above the top end of our guided range reflecting strong operational execution and increasing customer demand," said James Xiao, CEO. "The long-term outlook for semiconductor manufacturing remains compelling as AI continues to drive investment across the industry. Our priority is executing UCT 3.0 by expanding our global manufacturing capacity, enhancing engineering and operational capabilities, and accelerating digital transformation. Together, these initiatives position us to support our customers with greater speed, agility, and scale while delivering sustainable, profitable growth and creating long-term value for our shareholders."
